sources.note: F2 requires three consecutive completed lower-level movement types
minimal pan/trend construction may extend; not terminal evidence
third type point requires lower-level departure and first retrace, nonbroken boundary
three consecutive same-price trades initialize lowest center
lowest upward trend ends when N-th center (N>2) no longer higher; downward is converse; precise interval comparator unresolved
segment termination needs feature sequence gap branch
auxiliary/middle pen membership cannot be declared completed immediately
pen break not equal segment break
f1 initializer can differ from f2 recursive rule

raw_claim_bundle_contract.policy_requirement: all graph nodes must use same frozen analysis policy id
raw_claim_bundle_contract.raw_provenance: RAW_TRADE.source_digest and stream_id are caller-supplied and NOT authenticated by this tool
raw_claim_bundle_contract.time_requirement: discrete observation ordinal, first_seen_seq, historical_endpoint_seq; first_seen_seq may follow physical turning point and must not precede dependencies
semantic_guards: F1_CENTER: exactly three consecutive raw trade ordinals with identical prices; never claim the sole pan movement has ended
F1_TREND_NONADVANCE: N>2 and previous/Nth F1 center, upward not-higher or downward not-lower; market range comparator under-specified, only a declared predicate, not independently verified
F2_CENTER: exactly three consecutive FINISHED_MOVEMENT at child level, inclusive decimal price intersection; child exits still need independent certification
THIRD_POINT: same-level center plus completed lower departure and first-retrace; first-ness cannot be authenticated by graph labels alone; buy retrace-low>=ZG, sell retrace-high<=ZD
PAN_EXIT: same-level THIRD_POINT and center; cannot certify its own lower retrace
TREND_EXIT: divergence and pullback independent externally authenticated content required; not derived from segment-end
SEGMENT_END cannot be used as FINISHED_MOVEMENT or as direct third-point departure/retrace
graph must be acyclic, all references exist, and no node can first be seen before its dependencies
policy id, source class, historical endpoint and first-known time cannot silently change
no graph can output market-validated completed movement without independently verified raw trade/segment/exit sources
